skill.summary: Automated deployment pipeline for AI agents. Build, test, and deploy applications with zero-downtime. Triggers: deployment, CI/CD, release automation, deploy...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of deployment-automation (v1.0.0):

- Provides a fully automated deployment pipeline for AI agents and applications.
- Supports multi-stage pipelines (build, test, stage, deploy) and custom pipeline definitions.
- Enables blue-green, canary, and rolling deployment strategies with optional canary percentage and batch controls.
- Includes automated health checks and instant, configurable rollback on deployment failure.
- Offers multi-environment promotion, approval gates, environment diffing, and notification integration.
- Designed for zero-downtime releases and instant rollback, supporting modern continuous deployment workflows.
